title: Skyline Rush — Economy Health
description: Chips/Cores flow and Supply Drop payout fairness. Implements 12_ANALYTICS_AND_OBSERVABILITY.md §Dashboards bullet 1. Panels whose targets carry "skylineMetricStatus": "placeholder" reference metrics this prototype does not emit yet and will render as No Data.

panels.title: Balance reconciliation errors (rate)
panels.description: Ledger sum vs. materialized economy_balance divergence. Any non-zero value breaks the server-authority invariant in CLAUDE.md §1 and pages via SkylineBalanceReconciliationError.

panels.title: Idempotent replay rate
panels.description: Idempotent-replay hits served from a stored original result instead of re-executing. SCOPE (RF-07): this counter is incremented at exactly three sites — duplicate purchase receipts (BillingService.validateReceipt), supply-drop opens replayed under a seen Idempotency-Key, and contract claims replayed under a seen Idempotency-Key (both EconomyService). Run submission and redeploy dedupe inside the ledger's idempotency-key constraint and are NOT counted here. A rise is consistent with clients flushing a backed-up offline outbox, but this is a server-side replay count, not a client outbox metric.

panels.title: Cores outflow — redeploy conversions
panels.description: Cores spent on Redeploy (the only in-run Cores sink). Read alongside the purchase funnel to see inflow vs. outflow.

panels.title: Run submissions vs. anti-cheat exclusions
panels.description: Chips inflow is bounded by accepted runs; excluded runs forfeit rewards (CLAUDE.md §5). A widening gap means either cheating or an over-tight plausibility bound.

panels.title: Supply Drop payout share vs. published odds
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER: skyline_supply_drop_payout_total and skyline_supply_drop_published_probability are not emitted by this prototype. Opens are persisted via IDatabase.recordSupplyDropOpen but never exported as a Prometheus series, and the disclosed table is served over HTTP rather than published as a gauge. Panel renders No Data until those exist. Backs the SkylineSupplyDropOddsDrift alert. RF-08: the denominator is wrapped in scalar() so the label-less total broadcasts across the by-(rarity) numerator; without it the two sides have different label sets and vector matching would drop every sample even once the metrics land.
